CHAPTER 7: DATA & ANALYTICS
Data without a question is noise. A question without data is
opinion.
Analytics is my domain. I have spent 25 years building, leading,
and rebuilding analytics functions across the pharmaceutical
industry. In that time, I have managed teams running K-means
segmentation, XGBoost predictive models, and LSTM time series
forecasting. I have built marketing mix models on third-party
claims data and patient journey analyses on syndicated health
datasets.
And the number one failure mode I have seen, without exception, is
not a technical failure. It is a framing failure. Teams build
analytically sophisticated models that answer the wrong question.
Or they build the right model but cannot translate the output into a
decision. The prompts in this chapter address both problems.
